claim: To set up multi-view orthographic blueprint references: in the Object Data Properties > Background Images panel, add one image per view (front, side/right, top, bottom), and for each one set its 'Axis' dropdown to that specific view (rather than 'All Views') so each reference image only displays when that matching orthographic view (Numpad 1/3/7/Ctrl+7) is active, instead of all reference images overlapping in every view.
supporting_evidence: Direct quote (2:26-3:37): "toggle down the background images section make sure that it is enabled... click add image... i'm going to load in the front view then if we hit one to go to front view five to toggle into orthographic mode then you can see the image displayed here in the background... let's do change the axis here from all views to front this way if we switch into side view it doesn't show anymore such that front view only shows in front view... we're going to load in the side view so we'll choose side view and we're going to set it to the right"
rejected_alternative: Leaving all background images set to 'All Views', which would overlap every reference image in every orthographic viewport
